meta.title: Dentalpin — The open source dental software your clinic actually owns
meta.description: Patients, calendar, odontogram, budgets and billing in one open, modular, modern platform. Your data, on your server — never on someone else's cloud.

hero.subtitle: Patients, calendar, odontogram, budgets and billing in one platform. You install it, you extend it, you keep it.

manifesto.title: The dental market has been selling the same software for years. We stopped waiting.
manifesto.body: Dozens of closed, expensive, region-locked products. Interfaces that look fifteen years old, data you don't really own, no path to AI. Dentalpin is the answer: an open, modern platform any clinic can adopt, any developer can extend and any community can translate. No hostages.

oss.title: Open Source
oss.body: Your clinic's data is yours. Your software should be too.

modular.title: Modular
modular.body: Start with the basics. Turn on what you need. Stop paying for what you don't.

global.title: Global by design
global.body: Localised from day one. Same core, any language, any country.

api.title: API-first
api.body: Every feature ships an API. Connect anything, automate the painful parts.

ai.title: AI-Ready
ai.body: Built to work with agents: smart scheduling, decision support, follow-ups that run themselves.

ux.title: Modern UX
ux.body: Calm interface, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts. Built to use eight hours a day without burning your eyes.

bento.title: Built for how a clinic actually works. Not for how a sales deck describes it.
bento.subtitle: Every feature is a module. Turn it on, turn it off or replace it whenever you want.

modular.title: A small core. Modules that plug in.
modular.body: The module system isn't a metaphor: each one ships a manifest, its own Alembic migration branch, YAML seeds, auto-registered navigation and an event bus subscription. Turn on what your clinic needs and forget the rest.

demo.title: Click anything. Tomorrow it's like new again.
demo.body: Public demo with realistic data. Five preset roles, all on the same password.

stack.title: A modern, deliberately boring stack.
stack.body: We pick what serious teams pick. Nothing exotic, nothing legacy.

oss.title: BSL 1.1 today. Apache 2.0 tomorrow.
oss.body: Dentalpin ships under Business Source License 1.1: free for any clinic, free to read, fork, contribute and build modules on top. The only line in the sand: you can't launch Dentalpin as a competing dental SaaS. After four years, each release flips automatically to Apache 2.0.

roadmap.title: What's next (without pretending we have dates).

items.title: Dedicated Payments module
items.body: Full lifecycle: charge, refund, void, reconcile. With events so other modules can react on their own.

items.title: More locales
items.body: PT, FR, DE and whatever the community ships next. The architecture is already there.

items.title: Real AI agents
items.body: Smart scheduling, automatic follow-ups and clinical decision support — always with a human in the approval loop.

cta.title: Up and running in minutes. Yours forever.
cta.subtitle: One docker compose up and you're in.

pricing.title: Free. Forever. The core, every module.
pricing.subtitle: Dentalpin is open source. Run it yourself, or join the waitlist for our managed version.

selfhost.title: Self-hosted
selfhost.description: Clone the repo, run docker compose, you're in. Every module included.
features: BSL 1.1 today → Apache 2.0 in four years

sponsors.title: Dentalpin runs on its community.
sponsors.body: If Dentalpin saves you hours every week, here are a few ways to give back:

items.a: Business Source License. Free for any clinic, free for any dev. The only restriction: you can't launch Dentalpin as a competing dental SaaS. After four years, each release flips automatically to Apache 2.0.

items.q: Can I resell it as SaaS?
items.a: Not as a competing dental practice management SaaS while the license is BSL. Anything else is fair game: implementation services, private hosting, support, custom modules.
Clone the repo, copy the .env, run docker compose up. The docs cover the rest. On a reasonable VPS, under thirty minutes.

items.q: What if my clinic is tiny?
items.a: Even better. Dentalpin runs comfortably on a €4/month VPS. No minimum users, no monthly invoices to babysit.

items.q: What if I need serious help?
items.a: That's what the optional services above are for: guided setup, annual support, custom modules.

featuresIndex.title: Every feature, a module. Every module, its own page.
featuresIndex.subtitle: They work independently. Turn on the ones your clinic needs and switch the rest off — without touching anything else.
